assessments.reasoning: The pinned project README describes dependent types and lists pi-types and sigma types. The archived Aya chapter identifies the same project locator and a distinct language with dependent types. Pi and sigma are the standard dependent function and pair constructions, respectively.

challenge.method: Distinguished Aya's language from its type checker and interpreter on printed PLOC page 6. Compared the pinned README's exact type enumeration against its separate implementation-prototype bullet.
challenge.results: The list concerns the language presented by the Aya project and does not transfer type-checker or implementation status into the language claim.

limitations: Descriptive document claim at the December 2023 pin. It establishes no level of implementation completeness.
